title: Review Desk Points of Judgement: The Basis of a Cleaning Fee at Approval
content:
**Rule.** The fee basis of a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee approved at review is worked out from the level held and the evidence on file: when the level held requires professional cleaning, a professional cleaning document is on the evidence ledger and a cleaning cost is on file, the fee basis is the cleaning cost on file; when the level held does not require professional cleaning and either a cleaning cost is on file or a fee was assessed on the report at review, the fee basis is the larger of the cleaning cost on file and the fee at the level, which is the fee assessed at review where one was assessed and the level's flat fee otherwise; in any other case the fee basis is the level's flat fee.

The fee basis is the amount the fee charged on approval is based on; the fee is held to its ceiling after that.

## Terms as the records show them

- **Requires professional cleaning.** Of the cleaning levels, only Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) requires professional cleaning or detailing; Levels 1, 2 and 3 do not.
- **Professional cleaning document.** A cleaning receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger.
- **Cleaning cost on file.** The receipt amount held on the assessment, when it is above $0.00.
- **Fee assessed at review.** The assessed fee on the assessment, when it is above $0.00 before approval.

## Decision table

| Level held | Professional cleaning document on the ledger | Cleaning cost on file | Fee assessed at review | Fee basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Level 4 | yes | yes | any | the cleaning cost on file |
| Level 4 | no | any | any | the level's flat fee |
| Level 4 | yes | no | any | the level's flat fee |
| Level 1, 2 or 3 | any | yes | yes | the larger of the cleaning cost and the fee assessed at review |
| Level 1, 2 or 3 | any | yes | no | the larger of the cleaning cost and the level's flat fee |
| Level 1, 2 or 3 | any | no | yes | the fee assessed at review |
| Level 1, 2 or 3 | any | no | no | the level's flat fee |

## Cases (hypothetical amounts)

- Level 4, one cleaning receipt submission on the ledger, cleaning cost on file $214.50: the fee basis is $214.50, whether that is above or below the level's flat fee.
- Level 2, no cleaning cost on file, a fee of $83.20 assessed at review: the fee basis is $83.20.
- Level 3, no fee assessed at review, cleaning cost on file $140.00, flat fee $100.00: the fee basis is the larger, $140.00.
- Level 3, cleaning cost on file $72.00, fee assessed at review $110.00: the fee basis is $110.00.
